bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Tony, and I am from Las Vegas, Nevada. I am a first-generation college graduate from the University of Oregon (Sco Ducks!). I also have a graduate degree from the University of Washington. Currently, I am the director of compliance at Harvard Athletics, where I assist our student-athletes, coaches, and staff navigate the Ivy League and NCAA rules and regulations. This is my third year on campus with my wife, Alona, and our cat, Bublyk. We are excited to meet everyone and to be a resource to you in your first year at the College.
